name: Form 3 Physics: Newton's Laws of Motion
subject: Physics
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to state Newton's three laws of motion
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to solve problems on momentum and impulse
learningActivities: Discussion: learners share observations of moving objects
Demonstration: teacher uses a trolley to show conservation of momentum
Group work: learners solve momentum problems
Summary: learners relate the laws to everyday life
keyPoints: Momentum is the product of mass and velocity
Impulse is the product of force and time
In a collision, momentum is conserved
commonMisconceptions: Forgetting the direction of velocity in momentum calculations
lessonEvaluation: Learners solve three momentum problems and state Newton's laws.
teacherReflection: Good understanding. Link to collisions and safety features next lesson.
